orchestkit · chart-encoding-standard

The floor-CC path that cannot happen

chart-encoding-standard.md tells every chart-emitting skill to probe for CC's bundled /dataviz before using it. The prose was corrected in #3141. The worked example seven lines below it was not, and still named a failure path that the corrected prose had just ruled out.

Where the versions actually sit

2.1.198/dataviz bundled 2.1.220ork supported_floor

Every supported session sits at or above 2.1.220, which is above 2.1.198. There is no supported CC version that lacks /dataviz. A "floor-CC install" is therefore the best case for availability, not a risk.

The two absence paths, graded

impossible

floor-CC install
Ruled out by arithmetic: 2.1.198 < 2.1.220. This was the bug.

real

disableBundledSkills
The operator can switch bundled skills off at any version. The only genuine absence path.

real

validator returns hard FAIL
Skill present, output rejected. Same fallback applies.

The one-line change

src/skills/shared/rules/chart-encoding-standard.md:62

- ❌ WRONG:  assume /dataviz is present → chart breaks on a floor-CC or disabled install
+ ❌ WRONG:  assume /dataviz is present → chart breaks on a disableBundledSkills install
  ✅ RIGHT:  probe → present: validated chart · absent/FAIL: ASCII-card fallback (no regression)

The probe-before-use contract is unchanged. Only the named cause is corrected, so the example stops contradicting the paragraph directly above it.
